INSERT INTO order_item (id, order_id, item_type, dish_id, combo_id, snapshot_name, snapshot_image, snapshot_price, snapshot_calories, snapshot_protein, snapshot_fat, snapshot_carbs, snapshot_nutrition_json, quantity, sub_total, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{item.id}, #{item.orderId}, #{item.itemType}, #{item.dishId}, #{item.comboId}, #{item.snapshotName}, #{item.snapshotImage}, #{item.snapshotPrice}, #{item.snapshotCalories}, #{item.snapshotProtein}, #{item.snapshotFat}, #{item.snapshotCarbs}, #{item.snapshotNutritionJson}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.subTotal}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT oi.dish_id AS dishId, d.dish_name AS dishName, SUM(oi.quantity) AS totalQuantity FROM order_item oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN dish d ON oi.dish_id = d.id WHERE o.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND o.order_status = 50 AND oi.dish_id IS NOT NULL AND o.deleted = 0 AND oi.deleted = 0 GROUP BY oi.dish_id, d.dish_name ORDER BY totalQuantity DESC LIMIT #{limit}
